camel_example: aliyun alb AddServersToServerGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Servers.1.ServerType Ecs --Servers.1.Description test --Servers.1.ServerId 'i-uf616vu8me000000' --Servers.1.Port 80 --ServerGroupId 'sgp-atstuj3rtop0000' --Servers.1.Weight 100 --Servers.1.ServerIp '192.168.1.1' --Servers.1.RemoteIpEnabled false --method POST --force
description_en: Adds backend servers to a server group
description_zh: 向服务器组中添加后端服务器
kebab_example: aliyun alb add-servers-to-server-group --server-group-id sgp-atstuj3rtop0000 --servers ServerType=Ecs Description=test ServerId=i-uf616vu8me000000 Port=80 ServerIp=192.168.1.1 RemoteIpEnabled=false Weight=100 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddServersToServerGroup

fields.help_en: The description of the backend server. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 后端服务器描述。长度为 2~256 个英文或中文字符，不能以http://和https://开头
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The port used by the backend server. Valid values: 1 to 65535. You can add up to 200 servers in a single call.

This parameter is required when ServerType is set to Ecs, Eni, Eci, or Ip. This parameter is not required when ServerType is set to Fc
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器使用的端口。取值范围：1~65535。 单次调用最多支持添加200个服务器。

当ServerType取值为Ecs、Eni、Eci、Ip时，该参数必传。当ServerType取值为Fc时，无需配置该参数
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the remote IP feature. You can add up to 200 servers in a single call. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false: disabled.


This parameter takes effect only when ServerType is set to Ip
fields.help_zh:
是否开启远端IP功能。 单次调用最多支持添加200个服务器。取值：

true：开启。

false：不开启。


当ServerType取值为Ip时，该参数有效
fields.name: remote_ip_enabled

fields.help_en:
The backend server ID. You can add up to 200 servers in a single call.

If the server group is of the Instance type, this parameter specifies the resource ID of an Ecs, Eni, or Eci instance.

If the server group is of the Ip type, this parameter specifies an IP address.

If the server group is of the Fc type, this parameter specifies the Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of a Function Compute function
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器ID。 单次调用最多支持添加200个服务器。

当服务器组为Instance类型时，该参数为Ecs、Eni、Eci的资源Id。

当服务器组为Ip类型时，该参数为IP地址。

当服务器组为Fc时，该参数为函数计算的ARN标识
fields.name: server_id

fields.help_en:
The IP address. You can add up to 200 servers in a single call.

When ServerType is set to Eni, you can specify the primary private IP address or a secondary private IP address of the ENI.

This parameter is not required when ServerType is set to Fc
fields.help_zh:
指定IP地址。 单次调用最多支持添加200个服务器。

当ServerType为Eni时，支持指定ENI的主私网IP或辅助私网IP。

ServerType取值为Fc时，无需配置该参数
fields.name: server_ip

fields.help_en:
The server type of the backend server. You can add up to 200 servers in a single invoke. Valid values:
Ecs: ECS instance.
Eni: ENI network interface controller (NIC) instance.
Eci: ECI elastic container instance.
Ip: IP address.
Fc: Function Compute
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器类型。 单次调用最多支持添加200个服务器。取值：
Ecs：ECS实例。
Eni：ENI弹性网卡实例。
Eci：ECI弹性容器。
Ip：IP地址。
Fc：函数计算
fields.name: server_type

fields.help_en:
The weight of the backend server. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 100. If the weight is set to 0, no requests are forwarded to the backend server. You can add up to 200 servers in a single call.

This parameter is not required when ServerType is set to Fc
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器的权重，取值范围：0~100。默认值为100。如果设置权重为0，则不会将请求转发给该后端服务器。 单次调用最多支持添加200个服务器。

ServerType取值为Fc时，无需配置该参数
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The list of backend servers. You can add up to 200 servers in a single call
parameters.help_zh: 后端服务器列表， 单次调用最多支持添加200个服务器
parameters.name: servers

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without adding backend servers to the server group. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会向服务器组中添加后端服务器。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run
